details: Original 60-event recording with capture failures retained. Later 98-event and accepted-build 63-event recordings have gaps=[], errors=0, dropped=0.

error: Negative HTTP route fixtures in review/engineering were classified as excluded application entrypoints; JavaScript fixture copies also had no installed TS parser
fix: Moved original fixtures intact to dedicated .validation/archived-engineering and changed future test output location to .validation/engineering. Did not weaken scanner or install unneeded application language support.

error: Terminating a Windows venv redirector did not terminate its actual worker descendants; occupied ports prevented restart
fix: Stop only a verified trial-owned process tree using taskkill /T; launcher cleanup now does the same for its own children

error: Treating aria-pressed buttons as checkbox controls and pointer-clicking semantic nodes covered by canvas did not provide reliable expansion
fix: Read fresh AX state; use actual button click for code toggle and keyboard Enter for semantic graph expansion
classification: Trial interaction mistake; not an application business failure

error: CUA read-only evaluation does not expose application window.graphDebug
fix: Isolated bo_serve wrapper exposes existing renderer getter results as a DOM data attribute only; no geometry changes, business writes or fabricated events

error: Initial adapter reused one call identity across domain, flow and guard nodes
fix: Isolated adapter allocates per-call identity and native step context, retaining actual parent relationships. Exact event checks now enforce one node per call ID.

error: Pure geometry .mjs under review triggered excluded-entrypoint inspection and missing JS parser; gate rejected it
fix: Moved the pure math acceptance script into .validation, preserved original failed gate JSON, kept scanner unchanged

error: First event comparison sampled pending async business-list events; second attempted /api/view while debug Web was deliberately disabled and received no events field
fix: Allow existing business capture to settle, compare diagnostic reads before disabling and after restoring, preserve actual 404 during disabled mode
classification: Acceptance script errors; business mode-independent execution then passed

error: Script initially read guard.outputs.passed, but actual declared probe field is allowed
fix: Read actual declaration and event, compare allowed values against journal without changing captured data

error: Steps claim, record_result and confirm each show duplicate identical flow rows although actual transition occurs once
location: static/graph/replay-steps.js owner-to-row expansion near line 265 is a localization lead; upstream confirms root cause
fix: No trial viewer modification or display filtering; original 63-event recording and actual screenshots retained for upstream regression
